title: Count it out, symbol by symbol
caption: Swiss apartment floor: 20 doors, each read from the CAD layers and numbered on the drawing and in the list, so you can check the count in seconds. On the right: how far to trust it, in words, and a second, independent method that agrees. No AI model call: $0.
question: How many doors (interior doors and entrance doors together) are drawn on this floor plan?

title: Ask in German, compare with frontier models
caption: Net living area of apartment A: each room is outlined with its own m², and the list adds up to 62.74 m², the dataset's answer. Below the answer, the same question put to five frontier models given the same drawing: all five missed it (59 to 75 m²).
question: Wie gross ist die Nettowohnfläche von Wohnung A in m² (Summe aller Räume ohne Balkone, Loggien, Terrassen und andere Aussenräume)?

title: Disagree? Correct it with a click
caption: The evidence is the answer. Untick an item (here window #4) or click the drawing to add one the solver missed: the total updates on the spot, and the correction is saved as feedback for the next training run.
question: How many windows are drawn on this floor plan?

title: A Finnish plan, asked in Finnish
caption: A raster plan with no CAD file: a small detector we trained boxes each door it counted (5). Our fine-tuned vision model says 4, so the app flags the conflict and says in words to check. The five boxes make that a five-second check; 5 is right.
question: Kuinka monta ovea pohjapiirustuksessa on? Laske oviaukot, joissa on ovi; pelkkiä oviaukkoja ilman ovilehteä ei lasketa.

title: A plan rendered from a BIM model
caption: The doors are numbered on the plan PDF, and each one is an IFC element: switch to 3D and the same doors light up in the model.
question: How many doors are shown on the floor plan of 'Grundplan'?

title: Wall lengths, asked in Danish, in 3D
caption: Every wall that adds to the total lights up on its storey, with its own length in the list. “Why this answer” shows the arithmetic: 21 walls, summed exactly from the model.
question: Hvad er den samlede længde af alle vægge på 'Grundplan' i meter?

title: Rooms inside the building
caption: Click any element in 3D, or untick its row, to drop it from the answer. When you agree, mark it as checked and download the whole session as a takeoff CSV.
question: How many rooms (spaces) are shown on the floor plan of 'Grundplan'?
